newsitem.title: USA: Ashland has no comment on Nigeria action.
newsitem.headline: Ashland has no comment on Nigeria action.

text.p: Ashland Inc said it has no comment on a report that Nigeria has canceled its oil production contracts there.
"We are reviewing the situation carefully and have no further comment to make on issues surrounding our Nigerian exploration and production operations at this time," the company said.

Nigeria's oil ministry earlier said all work permits and expatriate quota granted to staff of Ashland based on their petroleum operations in the country had been revoked. It accused Ashland of transferring its interests to a third party without official consent.
The company, which has restructured operations in recent months, is in talks to sell the Nigerian properties and a deal is considered imminent.
It was not known how the action would impact the company' plans to sell the properties.
Ashland produces about 20,000 barrels per day from its Nigerian properties.
